newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pharmacia & Upjohn rises 3.3 pct on Q3.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn rises 3.3 pct on Q3.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn share price rose 3.3 percent after the company's third quarter results on Thursday calmed fears that followed a profit warning earlier this autumn.
At 1230 GMT the company's shares were eight crowns higher at 251 crowns.
"It does appear there is nothing sinister and operations are moving along quite well," analyst Stephen Putnam from Kleinwort Benson told Reuters.
Following a surpise profit warning three weeks ago, P&U posted lower earnings for the third quarter of $204 million against $231 million in the corresponding period a year ago.
